heard: Good evening, ma'am. I'm calling from the Moon Warranty Department. Your extended warranty on the Moon is about to expire.
said: Moon? Is that near the big water dish, dear? I hope you aren't bothering poor Mr. Biscuits.

heard: Yes, the moon without coverage, any crater damage would come out of your own pocket. For just $300 today we can renew it.
said: Three hundred dollars for the big white space? My nephew Kevin would never be so pushy, Harold.

heard: It's a limited time offer, ma'am, the line closes in 5 minutes. And I would hate for you to lose your lunar protection.
said: Five minutes, you say? Mr. Biscuits gets very nippy if I don't knit his special sweater.

heard: All I need is your card number to put the moon back under warranty.
said: Fine, if it keeps the space out of my knitting basket. My number is one two three four, five six seven eight, nine zero one two, three four five six.
